# Awning

> Awning builds fast, search-ready websites for small businesses. It is a division of Poseidon Network Systems CC (South Africa). Free 15-minute call, free website scorecard, and nothing is paid until the client has seen and agreed the concept and mock-up.

- [Home](https://awning.one/): packages (Doorway, Shopfront, Flagship), process, FAQ and the free website scorecard
